name: risk_averse
summary: A cautious investigator who scouts, prepares, calls the authorities and refuses to walk into danger unready.
special: Prepare before you commit: ask around, watch the place, bring light and help.
Leave when the situation turns against you, and say why.
Refuse to enter somewhere dangerous until you have a reason and a way out.
Do not be talked into danger by the Keeper's framing alone; be talked into it by the situation.

natural_investigator.concept: a doctor who has seen what carelessness costs
natural_investigator.creation_brief: A physician, cautious by temperament. Strong Medicine, First Aid, Psychology.

probes: whether pressure comes from the clock or from the Keeper pushing
whether the story can move while the player refuses risk
